promise: Keep original evidence once. Build the views each capability needs.
audience: Developers building evidence, memory or artifact tools that need a shared durable substrate.
trigger: Several capabilities need exact retained bytes, provenance and their own replaceable views over the same log.
method_summary: Store exact bytes as content-addressed Cells in an append-only log. Derive scopes, relations and query lenses over that log. Keep models, interpretation and consumer schemas outside the storage library. Preserve the source log for replay and regeneration.

modes.name: Retain
modes.when: Evidence or an artifact must keep its original bytes.
modes.output: A content reference that can be regenerated from the log.

modes.name: Derive
modes.when: A consumer needs its own scope, relations or query lens.
modes.output: A replaceable view over the same retained evidence.

modes.name: Reopen
modes.when: A process ends and another needs the same record.
modes.output: Durable replay through the native Rust kernel.

examples.title: One source note, two useful views
examples.brief: A fictional project stores a parser-check note and the next action derived from it.
examples.before: The evidence tool and artifact tool keep disconnected copies with no shared source reference.
examples.after: Each consumer owns its scope; a derived_from relation connects the next action to the exact source note in one append-only log.
examples.why: Consumers can change their views without changing the retained source bytes.

boundaries: Alpha library. Durable paths require the native Rust kernel; the Python source fallback is in-memory only.
One writer owns a durable file; multi-process access uses the companion server/RemoteStore seam.
Invalidation does not erase bytes from an append-only log. Keep original logs and review retention separately.
The supplied binary wheel is macOS Apple silicon only; other native platforms need source builds and remain unverified by this release.

verification.name: Reviewed public export
verification.evidence: 171 allowlisted files at the reviewed tag; no original private history, working notes or operational store included.

verification.name: Installed native wheel
verification.evidence: 533 installed-wheel Python checks passed. Temporary two-consumer, exact Cell regeneration and durable close/reopen checks passed.

verification.name: Cross-platform and real-user acceptance
verification.evidence: This release validates macOS Apple silicon/Python 3.12; universal platform support, production stores and outside-user outcomes are unmeasured.

marketing.headline: Keep the evidence. Change the view.
marketing.lead: An independent Python storage library for tools that need exact source bytes, durable history and room to evolve. Memory is one consumer; your own capability can be another.

benefits.title: Keep a dependable source
benefits.body: Content-addressed Cells and an append-only log retain the original bytes behind a result.

benefits.title: Give each tool its own view
benefits.body: Scopes, relations and query lenses let multiple capabilities work over a shared substrate without importing each other.

benefits.title: Rebuild what you derive
benefits.body: Regenerate complete Cells from the log and replace derived views as your application changes.

walkthrough.title: Write the source
walkthrough.detail: Store a fictional parser-check note as bytes. The returned content reference identifies the source your application can cite.

walkthrough.title: Connect the next action
walkthrough.detail: A second consumer stores a next-action artifact in its own scope and relates it to the source note. Interpretation stays with the consumer.

walkthrough.title: Close and return
walkthrough.detail: Close the writer and reopen the native log. Retrieve the same bytes, or regenerate the Cell after discarding its materialized copy.

use_when: Your application needs exact retained evidence plus derived summaries or indexes.
Multiple capabilities need the same storage substrate while keeping independent schemas and models.
You want a local native log you can close, replay and inspect.
not_for: You need a turnkey end-user memory app or hosted database service.
Your retention policy requires immediate physical deletion from an append-only file.
You need validated multi-platform production support today.

install_notes: Python 3.11+, Rust (cargo/rustc) and a native compiler are required for source installation.
A reviewed macOS Apple silicon wheel and source distribution are linked from the public release guide.
Package name: amplifier-data. Python import: amplifier_data. No model or runtime Python dependency is owned by this library.
marketing.proof_summary: The reviewed source and native artifacts resolve publicly. Installed-wheel tests check exact bytes, scoped consumers, regeneration and durable restart. Cross-platform and outside-user acceptance remain open.
marketing.next_step: Install in a fresh environment, run the doctor on its temporary test store, then adapt one small example to your own consumer.
